options.name: A — the page as it stands
options.claim: Round 13 option C, shipped today: text left, plate-over-mark right, no art below the fold. The incumbent, and the baseline every other row is a delta from. Its measured weakness is not the hero, it is the mid-page: 9 empty runs over 25.1% of the page, and a 1606px `bg-panel` section that carries no art.

options.name: B — the drawing opens the page
options.claim: Byrne before the headline. The hero stops being two columns and becomes a stack: a full-width band of the engraving above the fold, then the words, then the mark at its natural 240px. This is how Byrne’s own books open — the figure, then the proposition. Costs the most colour of any option (the widest window on the leaf the page is allowed one of) and the most resolution shortfall, because 1192px of band is painted from a 1024px scan.

options.name: C — a horizon in the middle of the page
options.claim: Keep the hero exactly as ruled, and put the line-work plate full-width between the club’s reasons and the schedule — where the page is emptiest by measurement. 1910 geometry is colourless, so this buys a horizon for almost no colour (record 0023 measured the 1910 plate at 0.000% at chroma >= 0.08) and it sits in a section that already pays for py-16 of padding.

options.name: D — one graphic per place, mark at the foot
options.claim: The answer to "can they go elsewhere": yes, and each place gets one job. The hero column holds only the plate, at the column’s full height (574px, so the widest honest window on the leaf the column already pays for); the identity mark moves out of the fold and closes the page in the ink footer, where it has to be repainted to survive a dark ground: measured in this round, moving it with only its ink strokes repainted left the gold paths at **2.5** against ink — under the 3.0 graphic bar (D101), twelve FAILs — so the option includes `--color-gold-on-ink` (5.80 on ink), the token the system already has; PS-3 takes the line-work plate; and the schedule notice takes the 323x110 thumb the operator ruled (a). The art-forward page.

options.name: E — the plate on an ink spine
options.claim: The boldest look on the table: the hero’s media column becomes a dark band that runs to the page’s right edge, so the engraving hangs on ink like a print in a hallway and the footer and the hero share one ground. It changes the page’s darkest surface, not just its art, so it is the option most likely to move the ground and contrast gates — which is why it is measured rather than admired.
